title: Event
description: One line of an append-only events/*.jsonl file. Metadata only: data holds at most 32 scalar fields and strings of at most 256 characters, so prompt text and file contents cannot be stored by accident.

event.description: Event name, for example PreToolUse, SubagentStop or task.start.

project_id.description: null when no registry entry matched the working directory.

project_source.description: How project_id was decided: registry path match, the git common directory of a worktree, a manual override, or none.

agent.description: Present when the event came from inside a subagent.

tool_id.description: The agent tool that produced the record, for example claude-code.

slot_name.description: Worktree slot name. A name, never an absolute path, so reports carry no local paths.
